name: fire elemental
desc: Fire Elemental is a CR 5 elemental.

actions.name: fire form
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without &reference[squeezing]{Squeezing}. A creature that touches the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} or hits it with a melee attack while within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=3xh7g2u2KGcjZSe4]] of it takes [[/damage average]] damage. In addition, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes [[/damage average]] damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes [[/damage average]] damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: illumination
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sheds &reference[bright light] in a 30-foot radius and &reference[dim light] in an additional 30 feet.

actions.name: water susceptibility
actions.desc: For every 5 feet the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes [[/damage]] damage.

actions.name: touch
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes [[/damage activity=dFEUCLc4Cmb2DETC average]] damage at the start of each of its turns.
